notes: Modified cash basis school district (FYE 8/31/2025). Governmental funds statement (Exhibit III, Total Governmental Funds column, pp16-19) used; School Nutrition Fund is shown within governmental funds in this report so it is treated as governmental; no business-type funds, so business_type is null. Beginning cash = beginning modified cash fund balance 13,157,096.49 (p18); ending cash = total assets/fund balance 14,155,708.99 (p18, cash and deposits 13,205,529.47 + county treasurer 950,179.52). Identity: 13,157,096.49 + 13,684,496.60 - 12,685,884.10 + 141,500 - 141,500 = 14,155,708.99. Statement receipt lines Local/State are broad groups recorded as printed with best-fit category and review; fine detail is in detail[]. 'Debt Service' 501,110 split into principal 285,000 and interest/fees 216,110 using Schedules H and J. General Fund spending detail comes from Schedule M (object by program, p36-47), which supersedes Schedule B (program totals), so Schedule B is not repeated; zero-dollar and blank-actual lines (e.g., 1150, 1292, 2162, 2163, 2172, 2182, 2620, 2732, 6310) omitted. Schedule M ends with transfers to School Nutrition -141,500, recorded as other financing (the printed total 10,686,653.14 includes it). Nameplate capacity tax recorded as other taxes. Allocations from General Fund to Depreciation (146,260) and Employee Benefit (100,942.57) funds appear as non-revenue receipts in the statement with no matching General Fund outflow; see decision_needed. Fund balance classes (p19): committed 5,178,987.15, assigned 4,402,636.42, unassigned 4,574,085.42. Statement of Activities (pp2-7) and General Fund budget comparison A-1 (p20) not separately captured; no Schedule K in trimmed pages. Read pages 1-47 of 47.
